about.title: About me
paragraphs: For years I've been doing one thing: building digital products and figuring out how to make people actually want to use them. Code, design and advertising are one job to me, not three departments.

IQElite in Barcelona, a matching platform built on psychometric tests: first CTO on the founding team, then CEO eighteen months later. The company was losing money; within 90 days it reached break-even and stayed profitable for the next 8 years. The platform grew to 8 million registered users.

Then Mentorist, an app that helps people apply what they read in books. A €550k round, 500k+ users and 500+ A/B tests. Those tests taught me more than anything about what people actually do in an app versus what they say they do.

Today I run Subida AI, a studio that builds, designs and markets mobile apps. AI agents write code, ad creatives and landing pages with me, so a small team ships what used to take an entire department.
This site is about me, not a sales pitch. If you're looking for a team to build your app, head to subida.ai.

bio.short: Greg Swierad is the founder of Subida AI, a mobile app studio, and of Mentorist (500k+ users, 500+ A/B tests, €550k raised). Before that: CTO, then CEO of IQElite (8M registered users), which reached break-even within 90 days. Today Greg builds products with AI agents and talks about what actually drives app growth.
bio.long:
Greg Swierad is the founder of Subida AI, a studio that builds, designs and markets mobile apps.

At IQElite in Barcelona, a matching platform built on psychometric tests, Greg started as CTO on the founding team and became CEO eighteen months later. Within 90 days of that change the company reached break-even and stayed profitable for 8 years; the platform grew to 8 million registered users.

Then came Mentorist, an app that helps people apply what they read in books: a €550k round, 500k+ users and 500+ A/B tests. Add to that €700k+ spent on Meta ads, a pre-sale of 500 copies of Silne Dziecko, and the campaigns that took the Neurony Szaleją brand to six-figure yearly revenue.

At Subida AI, Greg leads projects such as English Series (an app built end to end) and Lighthouse (product design, marketing and growth). AI agents are part of the daily workflow; with their help the team won HackYeah 2025.

items.a: Greg Swierad (Grzegorz Świerad) is a Polish founder who builds mobile apps and the growth behind them. He runs Subida AI, a mobile app studio, and created Mentorist, an app with 500k+ users, 500+ A/B tests and a €550k round. Before that he was CTO and then CEO of IQElite in Barcelona, which reached break-even within 90 days and grew to 8 million registered users.

items.q: What does Greg Swierad talk about on podcasts?
items.a: Six topics where he has his own numbers: what 500+ A/B tests teach about apps, growing Mentorist from zero to 500k+ users, building products with AI agents instead of a department, the IQElite turnaround from CTO to CEO, advertising that pays for itself (€700k+ spent on Meta ads), and why product design and marketing are one decision.

items.q: Which podcasts is Greg Swierad a good guest for?
items.a: Shows about startups, mobile and subscription apps, growth and performance marketing, product management, and building products with AI. Listeners who get the most out of it are founders, product managers, marketers and developers who want real numbers rather than theory.

items.q: How do I invite Greg Swierad on my podcast?
items.a: Use the form on gregswierad.com/podcast and say a few words about the show and its listeners. Greg replies within 24 hours, records remotely on the host's platform (Riverside, Zoom, StreamYard and others) and speaks English and Polish. The bio, photos and sample questions are on the same page.

items.q: Does Greg Swierad build apps for clients?
items.a: Yes, through his studio Subida AI (subida.ai), which builds, designs and markets mobile apps. This site is about Greg as a person and podcast guest; app projects start at subida.ai.

A free month of Naralingo, an app that turns real-life situations into personalised audio language lessons, and a Mentorist subscription. Listeners claim both at gregswierad.com/listeners (Polish: /dla-sluchaczy, Spanish: /oyentes).
